title: On the Quality of Cryptocurrency Markets: Centralized vs. Decentralized Exchanges
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date, not staggered. The only DiD (Table 6) compares DEX (Uniswap) with CEX trading costs and price deviations before and after the Uniswap v3 launch (V3_START = 5 May 2021, the same date for all pairs) using DEX x post with pair (entity) and time effects. Tables 3-5 regress costs/deviations on continuous gas fees (Table 5 instruments gas with NFT mints).
design_notes: 2023 7.1) Time-series analysis.py: post = date > 2021-05-05; DEX_X_post with entity_effects and time_effects via reg_tables; window Jan-Oct 2021.
data_files_note: README: data come from paid subscriptions (Dune Analytics, tardis.dev, theGraph, Infura); only Python code and a variable dictionary (datasets_with_descriptions.xlsx) are shipped.
